title: Characterizations of torsion abelian sheaves on the etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $F\in\Ab(T_{\Et})$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. The following are equivalent: (1) $F$ is torsion [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], i.e. the canonical map $\varinjlim_nF[n]\to F$ is an isomorphism; (2) every local section is locally killed by a positive integer: for every etale $U\to T$ and $s\in F(U)$ there are an etale covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and integers $n_i\ge1$ with $n_i\,s|_{U_i}=0$; (3) for every geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] $\bar t$ of $T$ the stalk $F_{\bar t}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is a torsion abelian group. Moreover these conditions do not imply that every group $F(U)$ is torsion: if $T\neq\emptyset$, the constant sheaf $\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $T_{\Et}$ is torsion, while its group of sections over the etale $T$-scheme $U=\coprod_{n\ge1}T$ contains $(1/2^n)_{n\ge1}$, an element of infinite order.
